name: FlyVRX - SciFi Mars Battle
summary:
An Action Arcade style SciFi Flight Simulation that puts in direct thrilling combat action on Mars. As a SciFi Jet pilot fly over Mars terrain and in space cities to engage with fast enemy jets and drones.

Dog-fight, survival and missions modes let you select different type of combat modes and action.

Features:
- Easy and smooth grab controls & navigation.
- Realistic Graphics and Environments
- realistic Mars terrain and enemy targets
- Missions, Survival, and Dog-Fight Mode
